title: Gift order with per-order limits and stock
prompt:
I'm buying gifts and I'd like:
- 3 x LIP-007-03 (Orrin Clear Lip Color, Mauve)
- 3 x FDN-009-201W (Halcyon Beauty Bare Foundation, light warm)
- 2 x LIP-004-01 (Orrin Calm Lip Color, Poppy)
- 1 x MSC-004-BLA (Tidepool Skin Cloud Mascara)
- 3 x SUN-007-50ml (Aurevia True Sunscreen)

Please add as many of each as the store allows in a single order. How many of each can I get, and what is my order total?
output_format: Return a JSON object of the form {"lines": [{"variant_id": "...", "quantity": integer}], "order_total": number}. Include every variant I asked for, with quantity 0 if none can be ordered. order_total includes promotions and shipping, in dollars with two decimals.
why_hard: Each line is capped by a different rule: a per-order limit of 1, a stock of 1 (below a per-order limit of 2), a sold-out mascara, and a per-order limit of 2 on an Aurevia item that also gets 20% off. The total is only right if every cap and the promotion are applied.
traps: FDN-009-201W has only 1 unit in stock (max_per_order is 2)
SUN-007 has max_per_order 2 and is discounted 20% (Aurevia, not new, not final sale)
